text: 【江苏银行被罚937万元 涉13项违法违规行为】中国人民银行日前披露行政处罚信息，江苏银行因违反金融统计、账户管理、收单业务、代收业务、数据安全、网络安全等管理规定，以及占压财政存款或资金、未按规定履行客户身份识别义务等13项违法违规行为，被警告、通报批评，没收违法所得0.17822万元，并罚款937.1万元。
text_en: [Bank of Jiangsu Fined 9.37 Million Yuan for Involving 13 Illegal and Non-compliant Acts] The People's Bank of China recently disclosed administrative penalty information. Bank of Jiangsu was warned and publicly reprimanded for violating regulations on financial statistics, account management, acquiring business, collection business, data security, network security, and other management rules, as well as for 13 illegal and non-compliant acts including occupying or withholding fiscal deposits or funds and failing to perform customer identity identification obligations as required, with illegal gains of 0.17822 million yuan confiscated and a fine of 9.371 million yuan imposed.
